prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: design a shippable personal progress tracker called "Inference Track" for a Java backend engineer completing an eight-week production LLM inference roadmap.
Surface structure: no sidebar and no marketing hero. A compact top strip contains the product name, a restrained overall progress measure, and "Week 1 of 8". Below it, the screen is dominated by one continuous full-width benchmark ledger with eight horizontal week rows. The active row is expanded in place and occupies roughly half the visible content area; the other weeks remain compressed rows above and below. In the expanded row show three concrete checkbox deliverables, a short "proof" field, an hours target, and a small notes area. Visible week labels should include "01 Foundations", "02 Java gateway", "03 Benchmarking", "04 Quantization", "05 Observability", "06 Kubernetes", "07 Reliability", "08 Capstone".
Visual world: an inference benchmark result sheet and engineering run log, contemporary rather than retro. Off-white matte ground, near-black ink, deep green status ink, pale sage rules. Ruled rows, tabular figures, crisp typographic alignment. Restrained color strategy. One active-week marker. Completed work leaves visible checked evidence.
Typography: practical workhorse sans for body and a compact technical face for week numbers and metrics; high legibility.
Composition: desktop application at work, not a poster and not device-framed. The ledger is the unmistakable focal structure. Strong information hierarchy, generous but efficient spacing, minimal rounded corners, no floating cards.
Exact text where legible: "INFERENCE TRACK", "32% COMPLETE", "CURRENT · WEEK 03", "Benchmarking & tuning", "Run an open-loop load test", "Record TTFT, TPOT, queue time", "Publish the benchmark report", "PROOF OF WORK".
Constraints: accessible contrast; practical controls; no charts except the single overall progress line; no gradients; no glassmorphism; no illustrations; no photography; no logos; no decorative icons; no fabricated performance claims; no extra navigation; no watermark. Render as a polished real product UI screenshot with enough of the next rows visible to prove the whole surface.
